method: Pair ADC = ln(S_lo/S_hi)/(b_hi-b_lo); low-b = OLS of ln S on b over b0/100/500/1000 (free intercept, 7-b scans); plateau = least squares of S/S0 to (1-f)exp(-D(b-b0))+f with D<=0.01, f<=0.5 (7-b scans); signals: noise-subtracted first navigator echo, raw first navigator L2 (Oct 7 convention), fixed-interior image mean, fixed-interior noise-corrected rms. basis nominal uses requested b, effective uses effective_b() (see assumptions). No uncertainty estimates.
b_effective_assumptions: E1 b(b_nominal) = lobes(b) + self + cross(b) for v1.8/v1.81, with lobes = b*f(b) (f piecewise-linear between the 100/1000/6000 knots of 0.9997/0.99647/0.99601), self = table b0 row, cross = c*sqrt(b/1000) (c = 167.45 or 0.25 for +x; sign flipped for -x on v1.8; absent for y; slice direction adds +37.3*sqrt(b/1000) on both). v1.91/v1.911: dev(b)=b_eff-b is fitted as s+alpha*b+beta*sqrt(b) to the four E1 table rows (residual reported by beff_fit_residuals). Echo e adds the b-independent offset (b0 row echo e - echo 1). Slice-direction cross term for v1.911 and y/-x terms for v1.911 are NOT in the report: assumed equal to the +x row / v1.81 value. Delta30 (scan I), 40 kHz readout (J, K) are not modeled: Delta40 / 50 us tables are used.
